headline: 9 Michigan deals, $10.1M raised — led by Esperion Therapeutics, Inc.

top_deals.summary: Esperion Therapeutics, Inc. (ESPR) reported completing an acquisition or disposition of assets; filing cites a figure of ~$1.1B.
Enspire Fund-A, LP, a Birmingham-based private equity fund, disclosed a $150M raise; $0 sold.
Blavin Capital Partners LLC, a Bloomfield Hills-based investment company, filed a $100M equity offering under Rule 506(b); $3M sold to 1 investor. (Amended filing.)
University Bancorp, Inc., an Ann Arbor-based company, filed a Form D tied to a business combination (acquisition or merger); $19.5M of debt issued to 12 investors.
Solu Oxford Holdings LLC, a Birmingham-based residential real estate company, filed an indefinite-size equity offering under Rule 506(b); $6.7M sold to 53 investors.

new_funds.summary: Enspire Fund-A, LP, a Birmingham-based private equity fund, disclosed a $150M raise; $0 sold.
Fontinalis Capital Partners IV, L.P., a Detroit-based venture capital fund, disclosed an open-ended (indefinite) raise; $0 sold.

material_agreements.summary: Rocket Companies, Inc. (RKT) entered into a material definitive agreement (credit facility).

talking_points.text: Michigan issuers reported $10.1M sold across 6 Form D filings this week, down 7% vs. the prior 4-week average. The largest was Blavin Capital Partners LLC (Bloomfield Hills, Investing) targeting $100M. Good question to ask: are founders in financial services favoring equity rounds over venture debt right now?

Esperion Therapeutics, Inc. (ESPR) closed a transaction. It was one of 2 M&A filings this week. Use it to ask how buyers are valuing Michigan health care & life sciences assets and whether consolidation is accelerating.

2 Michigan-based pooled funds filed Form Ds, reporting $0 raised so far — led by Enspire Fund-A, LP (Private Equity Fund). A natural opener: what are LPs asking Michigan sponsors for in today's fundraising market?
